title: Extract _extractUserMessage to lib/core/errors/user_message.dart
objective: Promote the private _extractUserMessage(Object?) helper duplicated in JoinBlockCubit and MeetingDetailsCubit into a shared top-level function in a new lib/core/errors/user_message.dart module, and replace both private copies with an import.
description: JoinBlockCubit (lib/ui/carnivalBlock/joinBlock/cubit/join_block_cubit.dart, lines 22-31) and MeetingDetailsCubit (lib/ui/meetings/meetingDetails/cubit/meeting_details_cubit.dart, lines 30-39) define byte-identical _extractUserMessage(Object?) helpers. They both strip the 'Exception: ' prefix and unwrap ApiError. The fix creates lib/core/errors/user_message.dart with one exported top-level function `String extractUserMessage(Object? error)` (public, no underscore), updates the import list of both cubits, and deletes the private methods. The function signature, semantics, and return values are preserved byte-identically — every existing call site (JoinBlockCubit lines 45, 53, 77, 80; MeetingDetailsCubit lines 64, 143, 153) keeps producing the same strings.

reference_files.reason: The private _extractUserMessage to delete. Also touch every call site (lines 45, 53, 77, 80) to use the new top-level function.
Same — private _extractUserMessage to delete. Touch call sites at lines 64, 143, 153.
Read-only context. The new module's first branch (`if (error is ApiError) return error.userMessage;`) consumes ApiError.userMessage.

fix_shape.new_file: lib/core/errors/user_message.dart — declares `import 'package:bloco_na_rua/core/api_error.dart';` and exposes `String extractUserMessage(Object? error) { if (error == null) return 'Erro desconhecido'; if (error is ApiError) return error.userMessage; if (error is Exception) { final msg = error.toString(); if (msg.startsWith('Exception: ')) return msg.substring(11); return msg; } return error.toString(); }`. The 'Erro desconhecido' literal and the 'Exception: ' prefix-strip logic are preserved byte-identically.
fix_shape.join_block_cubit_changes: Replace lines 22-31 with `import 'package:bloco_na_rua/core/errors/user_message.dart';`. Replace every `_extractUserMessage(` with `extractUserMessage(`.
fix_shape.meeting_details_cubit_changes: Same — replace lines 30-39, replace every `_extractUserMessage(` with `extractUserMessage(`.

flutter analyze lib/ returns no errors
